source.text: WATCH: Surveillance Video of Strong-Arm Robbery Linked to Michael Brown #Ferguson http://t.co/6fjtzxU063

selection_rule: Kept 30 comments with explicit support or opposition to the source tweet framing the surveillance video as linked to Michael Brown; excluded ambiguous, purely informational, off-topic, or weak social replies; balanced 15 support and 15 oppose where possible.
note: support = accepts the surveillance video as relevant/credible or uses it to challenge the innocent-victim narrative; oppose = disputes the video/relevance, argues it cannot justify the shooting, or frames the post as character assassination/media-police spin.
